items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: INTERVIEWER: ...this time you were using personnel from Nat Towles... [INTERVIEWEE] There was a band leader, a big guy, named Nat Towles out of Omaha, Nebraska. He had some excellent musicians with him.

ctx.x: I also have here that in early -- or no, in December of 1940, that you got the band together again. Apparently, there had been a time when you didn't have the band, and this time you were using personnel from Nat Towles -- is that it -- or Towles? I'm not familiar with that --
There was a band leader, a big guy, named Nat Towles out of Omaha, Nebraska. He had some excellent musicians with him.
